settings.description: About sessions, booking and what coaching is.

settings.text: If your question is not here, write to me.

settings.question: What happens on the free call?
settings.answer: We talk for 20 minutes about where you are and what you want to change. You leave with one clear next step, whether or not we work together.

settings.question: Is coaching the same as therapy?
settings.answer: No. Coaching looks forward: decisions, plans and habits. If something from the past keeps getting in the way, I will say so and suggest someone who can help.

settings.question: Do sessions happen online or in person?
settings.answer: Both. In person at my studio in Bristol, or on a video call from wherever you are. The programmes are the same either way.

settings.question: How do I book my times?
settings.answer: After you pay, you get an email with a link to choose your session times. You can book them all at once or one at a time.

settings.question: Can I move a session?
settings.answer: Yes, up to 24 hours before it starts, as often as you need. Closer than that, the session counts unless something urgent comes up.

settings.question: What if it is not right for me?
settings.answer: If you decide after the first paid session that it is not for you, tell me and I refund the sessions you have not used.

settings.heading: Ready when you are
settings.text: Book a free 20 minute call. No pressure and no pitch, just a real conversation about where you want to go.
